decal.description: Cosmetic damage decal id (never affects validation/topology).

DamageVariant.description: Asset damage variant, resolved at export time against the kit's intact/damaged/breached module variants. Structural role (`module_id`) stays stable; only the rendered asset changes.

DeckLayer.description: One deck's tile data as flat row-major arrays (index = y * width + x).

room_id.description: Room id per tile; NO_ROOM (0) = not part of any room (void/space).

oneOf.description: Interior of a multi-cell room: no wall, never materialized.

cell.description: The cell/direction this edge was first derived from (either side is valid; edge_key is what's canonical).

wrapper_required.description: Whether this edge demands a materialized placement (Open and BREACH holes don't).

id.description: Stable within this ship; assigned in deterministic order. Save diffs and co-op mutation replication address entities by this id.

proto.description: Prototype key, maps to a scene/visual on the Godot side ("bed", "locker", "helm_console", "hull_plate_debris", ...).

rotation.description: 0..=3, 90-degree steps. For doors: 0 = sits on north edge of pos, 1 = west edge.

oneOf.description: Open space / no floor (outside hull, or a breach hole).

PortalIntent.description: Authored doorway between two rooms sharing a real cardinal cell edge. Created at placement time by the topology stage — never derived post-hoc.

exterior.description: Exterior door (to_room == NO_ROOM): airlock onto space.

min.description: AABB in deck-local tile coords (min inclusive, max inclusive).

spans_room_id.description: For multi-deck logical systems (engineering spanning decks): the room id of the same logical room on the deck below, if any.

plan.description: The canonical structural plan — the AUTHORITATIVE geometry. Deck raster layers below are a derived projection of this.

template_id.description: Topology template that authored this ship.

topology.description: Authored topology (rooms with explicit occupancy, portal intents, vertical connections) — the compile input, kept for validation and export cross-checks.

ShipFragment.description: Metadata about one hull piece after a structural fracture. Tile data is already laid out in final world-local coordinates (fragments are baked apart into the shared deck grid), so this exists for debugging/AI hints, not for rendering math.

drift.description: Translation that was applied to this fragment when baking it apart.

rooms.description: Room ids belonging to this fragment.

placements.description: Materialized non-Open, wrapper-required edges (sorted by edge_key).

TileWalls.description: PZ-style: walls live on tile EDGES. Each tile stores its north and west edges; a tile's south edge is its south neighbor's north edge, etc.

oneOf.description: Door frame opening (a Door entity sits on this edge).
Wall destroyed by damage; passable, jagged.
